svg.title: Black Square with Blue
svg.desc: Schematic visual study after the cited photograph. Approximate geometry and standardized colors; wall and cast shadows omitted. MoMA2013 Chatham Series publication PDFpage9, fig8. Black square at upper-left joins a blue vertical rectangle halfway down its right edge. Transparent upper-right and lower-left cutouts retained.
